keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s dismissal of his action for declaration of title and ejectment. Held - compliance with Section 41 of the Civil Procedure Code was mandatory; the land in dispute had not been described with sufficient precision for execution of a decree. Appeal dismissed without costs.
